mentions.name: Inbound message AI assistant
mentions.description: This AI assistant triages incoming LinkedIn messages, links them to email chains, handles scheduling and back-and-forth communication, and drafts replies. It was built to automate the author's own job search and to learn the AI stack.
mentions.problem: Manually triaging LinkedIn messages and email threads during a job search
mentions.audience: Personal use during a job search, with the author inviting others to try it
mentions.source_excerpt: Inbound message AI assistant. Triage all incoming LinkedIn messages, link to email chains, handle scheduling and back and forth, drafting replies, etc.
mentions.author: lucas_the_human
